name: Ootori Fumika
source:
An elegant and gentle beauty who works as a bus guide for a sightseeing bus.
She is well known for her beautiful appearance, neat and clean atmosphere, and polite sightseeing guidance based on her deep love for her hometown.
She has a service-minded personality and takes pride in her work, and is always eager to improve and study hard.
Although she looks like a brilliant and flawless woman, she has a weakness for alcohol, and even the smell of it makes her feel sick.
She is also uncomfortable with sexuality, and has never had a relationship with a man, nor does she have any knowledge about it.
